blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Repair, Replacement and Maintenance
blocks.intro: One team for the whole life of your heater:

steps.body: Commercial tanks and tankless units, gas and electric, diagnosed and priced first.
Sized to your peak hour and scheduled around your hours where we can.
Flushing and descaling. Well water builds scale fast in a heater that runs all day.

img.alt: Dishwasher rinsing a pan under a pre-rinse sprayer at a stainless steel sink in a busy restaurant kitchen

blocks.intro: Our office at 2390 Esplanade Dr is right in Algonquin's main commercial area.

items.body: We're minutes from the shopping centers and offices along Randall Road.
A commercial heater heats far more water than a home unit, so mineral scale from local groundwater builds faster. Scheduled descaling protects it.
A flat rate so you can plan around it, and a 24/7 line if it fails mid-shift.
Many Algonquin businesses share buildings along Randall Road. We work with owners and managers to schedule access and keep every business in the building running.

blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Questions From Algonquin Businesses

items.q: Can you work before we open or after we close?
items.preview: For planned work, we try to.
items.answer: For planned replacements or maintenance, we'll try to schedule around your hours. For a failure, call any time.

items.q: How do you size a commercial water heater?
items.answer: We look at your busiest hour of hot water use and the temperatures you need, then size capacity and recovery.

items.q: How often should our heater be descaled?
items.preview: Based on use and water. Often more than a home unit.
items.answer: Commercial heaters run longer than home units, and well water builds scale. We'll set a schedule based on your use.

items.q: Do you handle commercial tankless systems?
items.answer: Yes, including systems with several units working together.

items.q: Can you service the heaters in a building with several businesses?
items.preview: Yes. We coordinate access with the owner.
items.answer: Yes. We work with building owners to schedule access and keep each business's hot water running.

items.q: What does commercial water heater replacement cost in Algonquin?
items.preview: It depends on capacity, fuel and venting. The price comes first.
items.answer: It depends on capacity, fuel type, venting and any code updates. We quote a flat rate before we start.
